text:
Devon: Heads-up — I'll be rolling the microbake slice to prod in 10m (10:15am). Samir & Alyssa please own smoke. Rolling 10% -> 50% -> 100%, 5m holds between steps.
ci-deploy-bot: Rollout job started: https://ci.redwood/rollouts/4567 — canary config applied.
Alyssa: on it. I'll run the sanity prompt set and the latency/throughput sweep. Posting quick checklist.
Alyssa: CHECKLIST: 1) run `curl` smoke endpoints 2) run embedding perf job 3) run core prompts through canary 4) verify KV cache hit >= 88%.
Samir: I'll be watching error budget and traces. If 5xx > 0.5% for >1min we pause and rollback.
Mariana: Reminder — rollback image is `redwood/inference:2026-03-17-rc3` and config v24. I have the rollback command pinned.
Devon: rollback command: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=24` — keep it handy.
observability-bot: Canary reached 10% traffic at 1774056900. Metrics: p50=36ms, p95=98ms, error_rate=0.04%.
Alyssa: first-pass smoke: endpoints return 200, top prompts within baseline, no tokenization errors so far. p95 slightly up (+6ms) on one shard.
Samir: I see a transient CPU spike on pod inference-2 (narrow GC pause). Dropping requests to that pod temporarily fixes spike. I'll drain and redeploy if it repeats.
Alyssa: small anomaly: one prompt produced extra trailing whitespace in generation for a specific prompt that hits the new tokenizer. Creating PR #8912 to tighten token normalization.
Devon: is PR blocking promote? If it's only cosmetic we can patch after full rollout. If it affects production parsing, stop.
Samir: not blocking for now, cosmetic. Recommend continue to 50% and hold 10m while we monitor.
ci-deploy-bot: Canary promoted to 50% at 1774057020.
observability-bot: During 50% window: KV cache hit rate steady at 90%, mem usage +3% but within headroom, error_rate=0.05%.
Mariana: I'm oncall for the next 2 hours. Ping me directly if you want a rollback assist.
Alyssa: after 10m hold, all checks green from my side. p99=140ms, no 5xx spikes, sample logs show no cache-miss regressions.
Devon: moving to 100% after final OK. Final promote in 2m.
ci-deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% at 1774057200. All pods running.
Samir: post-promote note — watch for subtle tokenization downstream in the first hour; I'm keeping tracing sampling high for the slice.
Alyssa: PR #8912 will be merged as a minor hotpatch if we see field parsing issues; not planning immediate rollback.
Devon: thanks everyone. Leaving this thread open for any quick fixes. If anything critical appears, follow rollback cadence documented in runbook. :thumbsup:
